label: Still-Life Optics
description: Tabletop and studio optics for food and product work — where the plane of focus lives and how the set falls away around it.

items.name: 100mm-tabletop
items.text: a 100mm macro at tabletop distance, one plane of critical sharpness placed deliberately on the hero, the rest of the set folding into soft falloff

items.name: tilt-swing-surface
items.text: a tilt lens swung so the plane of focus lies along the subject's top surface, sharpness following the form instead of the distance
items.text_short: tilt lens, focus along the surface

items.name: overhead-flat-lay
items.text: a 50mm mounted directly overhead for a graphic flat-lay, the set arranged like a page layout, zero convergence and honest proportions

items.name: 35mm-in-scene
items.text: a 35mm environmental view from a natural standing angle, the hero sharp inside a believable scene that blurs gently toward the edges

items.name: long-lens-compression
items.text: a 135mm from across the set, perspective flattened, background props swelling into large soft shapes behind the hero

items.name: probe-through-set
items.text: a probe lens weaving through the set at subject height, impossibly close perspective with foreground elements brushing past the frame edges

items.name: wide-open-slice
items.text: an 85mm at f/1.4, a millimeter-thin slice of focus on the single most important edge, everything else surrendered to atmosphere

items.name: stopped-down-true
items.text: stopped down to f/11 on a tripod, front-to-back sharpness across the hero, every material surface reading true to swatch
